notes: The tuition fact uses the DAAD page statement 'Tuition fees per semester None' (amountMinor 0, period semester). No application channel could be extracted because none of the pages name uni-assist, VPD, or a dedicated portal for international applicants. The requirement for 12 prior study years is inferred from the Abitur (usually 12 years) but the pages do not explicitly state a number of years; the quotes show the required school-leaving certificate and grade overview. Language of instruction: English and German, as the programme is bilingual in 3 specializations; some specializations are fully English.
